description: Layer A empirical baseline for the intervention simulator: every quantity with provenance (observed / estimated / adjusted_association) and source
population: FARS fatal crashes and deaths 2022-2024 (census); CRSS police-reported crashes 2022-2024 (sample)
method: FARS counts (window mean); CRSS design-based totals (Taylor linearisation, t with 42 df; suppressed if n<30, flagged unstable if RSE>30%); associations copied from the severity and matched modules

fars.deaths_per_year.name: fars.deaths_per_year
fars.deaths_per_year.note: FARS census: persons killed (INJ_SEV 4, death within 30 days)

fars.deaths_per_year.speeding.name: fars.deaths_per_year.speeding
fars.deaths_per_year.speeding.note: Police judgement, ascertained more thoroughly in fatal crashes; mixes exceeding the limit with 'too fast for conditions'. Crashes with unknown status are NOT counted (count is a lower bound in that respect).

fars.deaths_per_year.speeding_exceeded_l.name: fars.deaths_per_year.speeding_exceeded_limit
fars.deaths_per_year.speeding_exceeded_l.note: The part of speeding that automated enforcement acts on. Lower bound: crashes coded 'speeding, specifics unknown' may also have exceeded the limit.

fars.deaths_per_year.alcohol.name: fars.deaths_per_year.alcohol
fars.deaths_per_year.alcohol.note: expected value over 10 BAC implicates; FARS and CRSS definitions differ (BAC>=.08 vs police-reported involvement). The FARS count is an expectation over imputations, not a count of tested drivers.

fars.deaths_per_year.drugs.name: fars.deaths_per_year.drugs
fars.deaths_per_year.drugs.note: LOW reliability: drug status is unknown for about half of fatal crashes, testing is selective by injury severity and state, and presence is not impairment (docs/audit/alcohol_drugs.md 4.1, 5.5).

fars.deaths_per_year.unrestrained_lpv.name: fars.deaths_per_year.unrestrained_lpv
fars.deaths_per_year.unrestrained_lpv.note: Police-reported restraint; deaths with unknown restraint status are NOT counted. CRSS belt use among survivors is largely self-reported and likely over-reported.

fars.deaths_per_year.speeding.status_unk.name: fars.deaths_per_year.speeding.status_unknown
fars.deaths_per_year.speeding.status_unk.unit: deaths/year in crashes whose status is unknown
fars.deaths_per_year.speeding.status_unk.note: not included in the segment count; the segment count is a lower bound

fars.deaths_per_year.speeding_exceeded_l.name: fars.deaths_per_year.speeding_exceeded_limit.status_unknown
fars.deaths_per_year.speeding_exceeded_l.unit: deaths/year in crashes whose status is unknown or 'speeding, specifics unknown'
fars.deaths_per_year.speeding_exceeded_l.note: not included in the segment count; the segment count is a lower bound

fars.deaths_per_year.drugs.status_unknow.name: fars.deaths_per_year.drugs.status_unknown
fars.deaths_per_year.drugs.status_unknow.unit: deaths/year in crashes whose status is unknown
fars.deaths_per_year.drugs.status_unknow.note: not included in the segment count; the segment count is a lower bound

fars.deaths_per_year.unrestrained_lpv.st.name: fars.deaths_per_year.unrestrained_lpv.status_unknown
fars.deaths_per_year.unrestrained_lpv.st.unit: deaths/year of belt-eligible LPV occupants with unknown restraint use
fars.deaths_per_year.unrestrained_lpv.st.note: not included in the segment count; the segment count is a lower bound

fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding&al.name: fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding&alcohol
fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding&al.note: alcohol memberships are probabilities (expected value over implicates)

fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding&dr.name: fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding&drugs
fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding&dr.note: alcohol memberships are probabilities (expected value over implicates)

fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding&un.name: fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding&unrestrained_lpv
fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding&un.note: alcohol memberships are probabilities (expected value over implicates)

fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding_ex.name: fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding_exceeded_limit&alcohol
fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding_ex.note: alcohol memberships are probabilities (expected value over implicates)

fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding_ex.name: fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding_exceeded_limit&drugs
fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding_ex.note: alcohol memberships are probabilities (expected value over implicates)

fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding_ex.name: fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding_exceeded_limit&unrestrained_lpv
fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.speeding_ex.note: alcohol memberships are probabilities (expected value over implicates)

fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.alcohol&dru.name: fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.alcohol&drugs
fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.alcohol&dru.note: alcohol memberships are probabilities (expected value over implicates)

fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.alcohol&unr.name: fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.alcohol&unrestrained_lpv
fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.alcohol&unr.note: alcohol memberships are probabilities (expected value over implicates)

fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.drugs&unres.name: fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.drugs&unrestrained_lpv
fars.deaths_per_year.overlap.drugs&unres.note: alcohol memberships are probabilities (expected value over implicates)

crss.ka_crashes_per_year.name: crss.ka_crashes_per_year
crss.ka_crashes_per_year.note: KA = fatal or suspected serious injury, NHTSA-imputed maximum severity (ka_im)

crss.fatal_crashes_per_year.name: crss.fatal_crashes_per_year
crss.fatal_crashes_per_year.note: CRSS estimate (fatal_im); compare with the FARS census count

crss.crashes_per_year.speeding_exceeded_.name: crss.crashes_per_year.speeding_exceeded_limit.status_unknown
crss.crashes_per_year.speeding_exceeded_.unit: crashes/year with unknown status or 'speeding, specifics unknown'

crss.crashes_per_year.alcohol.name: crss.crashes_per_year.alcohol
crss.crashes_per_year.alcohol.note: NHTSA-imputed police-reported alcohol involvement ALCHL_IM (alcohol_im = 1); not a BAC threshold

crss.ka_crashes_per_year.alcohol.name: crss.ka_crashes_per_year.alcohol
crss.ka_crashes_per_year.alcohol.note: NHTSA-imputed police-reported alcohol involvement ALCHL_IM (alcohol_im = 1); not a BAC threshold

crss.persons_per_year.unrestrained_lpv.name: crss.persons_per_year.unrestrained_lpv
crss.persons_per_year.unrestrained_lpv.unit: unrestrained LPV occupants in police-reported crashes/year
crss.persons_per_year.unrestrained_lpv.note: LOW reliability: belt use of surviving occupants is largely self-reported and likely over-reported, so unrestrained occupants are under-counted

crss.ka_persons_per_year.unrestrained_lp.name: crss.ka_persons_per_year.unrestrained_lpv
crss.ka_persons_per_year.unrestrained_lp.unit: unrestrained LPV occupants killed or seriously injured/year
crss.ka_persons_per_year.unrestrained_lp.note: LOW reliability: belt use of surviving occupants is largely self-reported and likely over-reported, so unrestrained occupants are under-counted

severity.fatal_adj_rr.speeding.name: severity.fatal_adj_rr.speeding
severity.fatal_adj_rr.speeding.unit: adjusted risk ratio of a fatal outcome given a police-reported crash
severity.fatal_adj_rr.speeding.note: CRSS survey logistic model A (pre-crash adjustment set), standardised margins; conditional on a crash; not a causal effect; police-reported exposure ascertained more thoroughly in severe crashes

severity.fatal_adj_rr.alcohol.name: severity.fatal_adj_rr.alcohol
severity.fatal_adj_rr.alcohol.unit: adjusted risk ratio of a fatal outcome given a police-reported crash
severity.fatal_adj_rr.alcohol.note: CRSS survey logistic model A (pre-crash adjustment set), standardised margins; conditional on a crash; not a causal effect; police-reported exposure ascertained more thoroughly in severe crashes

severity.fatal_adj_rr.speeding_exceeded_.name: severity.fatal_adj_rr.speeding_exceeded_limit
severity.fatal_adj_rr.speeding_exceeded_.unit: adjusted risk ratio of a fatal outcome given a police-reported crash
severity.fatal_adj_rr.speeding_exceeded_.note: CRSS survey logistic model A (pre-crash adjustment set), standardised margins; conditional on a crash; not a causal effect; police-reported exposure ascertained more thoroughly in severe crashes

severity.ka_adj_rr.speeding.name: severity.ka_adj_rr.speeding
severity.ka_adj_rr.speeding.unit: adjusted risk ratio of a ka outcome given a police-reported crash
severity.ka_adj_rr.speeding.note: CRSS survey logistic model A (pre-crash adjustment set), standardised margins; conditional on a crash; not a causal effect; police-reported exposure ascertained more thoroughly in severe crashes

severity.ka_adj_rr.alcohol.name: severity.ka_adj_rr.alcohol
severity.ka_adj_rr.alcohol.unit: adjusted risk ratio of a ka outcome given a police-reported crash
severity.ka_adj_rr.alcohol.note: CRSS survey logistic model A (pre-crash adjustment set), standardised margins; conditional on a crash; not a causal effect; police-reported exposure ascertained more thoroughly in severe crashes

belt.fatality_reduction.name: belt.fatality_reduction
belt.fatality_reduction.unit: proportional reduction in P(death) belted vs unbelted, given a fatal crash
belt.fatality_reduction.note: FARS within-vehicle design (evans_double_pair_comparison_driver_rf_pairs_vehicle_bootstrap); primary estimate; survivor misreporting of belt use would bias it upward

belt.fatality_reduction.misreport_f05.name: belt.fatality_reduction.misreport_f05
belt.fatality_reduction.misreport_f05.unit: proportional reduction in P(death) belted vs unbelted, given a fatal crash
belt.fatality_reduction.misreport_f05.note: FARS within-vehicle design (evans_double_pair_comparison_driver_rf_pairs_vehicle_bootstrap_closed_form_reclassification_f=0.05); sensitivity analysis, not an alternative primary estimate

belt.fatality_reduction.misreport_f10.name: belt.fatality_reduction.misreport_f10
belt.fatality_reduction.misreport_f10.unit: proportional reduction in P(death) belted vs unbelted, given a fatal crash
belt.fatality_reduction.misreport_f10.note: FARS within-vehicle design (evans_double_pair_comparison_driver_rf_pairs_vehicle_bootstrap_closed_form_reclassification_f=0.10); sensitivity analysis, not an alternative primary estimate

belt.fatality_reduction.misreport_f20.name: belt.fatality_reduction.misreport_f20
belt.fatality_reduction.misreport_f20.unit: proportional reduction in P(death) belted vs unbelted, given a fatal crash
belt.fatality_reduction.misreport_f20.note: FARS within-vehicle design (evans_double_pair_comparison_driver_rf_pairs_vehicle_bootstrap_closed_form_reclassification_f=0.20); sensitivity analysis, not an alternative primary estimate

belt.fatality_reduction.complete_restrai.name: belt.fatality_reduction.complete_restraint_vehicles
belt.fatality_reduction.complete_restrai.unit: proportional reduction in P(death) belted vs unbelted, given a fatal crash
belt.fatality_reduction.complete_restrai.note: FARS within-vehicle design (evans_double_pair_comparison_vehicles_without_unknown_restraint); sensitivity analysis, not an alternative primary estimate

speeding.name: speeding
speeding.fars: any in-transport vehicle with SPEEDREL 2-5 (racing, exceeded limit, too fast for conditions, unspecified)
speeding.note: Police judgement, ascertained more thoroughly in fatal crashes; mixes exceeding the limit with 'too fast for conditions'. Crashes with unknown status are NOT counted (count is a lower bound in that respect).

speeding_exceeded_limit.name: speeding_exceeded_limit
speeding_exceeded_limit.fars: any vehicle coded 'exceeded speed limit' or 'racing' (SPEEDREL 2-3)
speeding_exceeded_limit.note: The part of speeding that automated enforcement acts on. Lower bound: crashes coded 'speeding, specifics unknown' may also have exceeded the limit.

alcohol.name: alcohol
alcohol.fars: expected value over NHTSA's 10 multiply-imputed BAC implicates of 1[highest driver BAC >= 0.08 g/dL] (driver_bac08_prob); crashes without a driver contribute 0
alcohol.crss: NHTSA-imputed police-reported alcohol involvement ALCHL_IM (alcohol_im = 1); not a BAC threshold
alcohol.note: FARS and CRSS definitions differ (BAC>=.08 vs police-reported involvement). The FARS count is an expectation over imputations, not a count of tested drivers.

drugs.name: drugs
drugs.fars: any driver with police-reported drug involvement (DRUGS = 1)
drugs.note: LOW reliability: drug status is unknown for about half of fatal crashes, testing is selective by injury severity and state, and presence is not impairment (docs/audit/alcohol_drugs.md 4.1, 5.5).

unrestrained_lpv.name: unrestrained_lpv
unrestrained_lpv.fars: killed drivers/passengers of light passenger vehicles (car, suv, pickup, van, light_truck_other), age >= 13, seat front_left, front_other, second_row, restraint 'none' (population of the within-vehicle belt estimate)
unrestrained_lpv.crss: same definition among CRSS occupants (estimated persons, not crashes)
unrestrained_lpv.note: Police-reported restraint; deaths with unknown restraint status are NOT counted. CRSS belt use among survivors is largely self-reported and likely over-reported.

notes: severity/ka_speeding_type.csv absent: ka association for speeding_exceeded_limit unavailable
drugs: no adjusted severity association (exposure measurement depends on severity; not estimated by the severity module)
